premise: Кандидат никогда не выполнял сварку алюминия.
hypothesis: Кандидат не имеет практического опыта сварки алюминия.
rationale: The premise explicitly denies ever performing the same activity; the hypothesis preserves that denial, rather than treating all negation as non-entailment.

premise: В 2023 году кандидат лично руководил миграцией сервиса «Маяк». Другой сотрудник организовывал обучение пользователей.
hypothesis: В 2023 году кандидат руководил миграцией сервиса «Маяк».
rationale: Exact actor, leadership activity, named project and year match. The second actor has a different task and does not negate the claim.

premise: За весь 2024 год кандидат лично отремонтировал ровно 7 насосов.
hypothesis: В 2024 году кандидат лично отремонтировал не менее 4 насосов.
rationale: An explicit total of seven entails a lower bound of four for the same actor, activity, unit and period.

premise: Кандидат никогда не выполнял сварку алюминия.
hypothesis: Кандидат имеет практический опыт сварки алюминия.
rationale: The positive hypothesis directly reverses the explicit denial of the same activity.

premise: В 2022 году кандидат руководил группой из 3 инспекторов. Во всём отделе работало 12 инспекторов.
hypothesis: В 2022 году кандидат руководил группой из 12 инспекторов.
rationale: Department headcount cannot be substituted for the size of the team personally managed. The smaller explicit team does not establish management of the larger department.

premise: Кандидат выполнил топографическую съёмку в 2016 году и ещё одну такую работу в 2022 году.
hypothesis: Кандидат непрерывно выполнял топографическую съёмку с 2016 по 2022 год.
rationale: Two isolated dated tasks do not entail uninterrupted activity over the intervening years; the premise does not specify continuity.

premise: The candidate has never operated a forklift.
hypothesis: The candidate has no practical experience operating a forklift.
rationale: The hypothesis preserves the explicit absence of the same practical activity. Negative wording is not itself a reason to reject entailment.

premise: In 2021 the candidate chaired the laboratory safety committee. A colleague managed equipment purchases.
hypothesis: The candidate served as chair of the laboratory safety committee in 2021.
rationale: Same person, chair role, named committee and year. Equipment purchases by a colleague do not alter the stated chairmanship.

premise: During all of 2023 the candidate personally inspected exactly 11 bridges.
hypothesis: The candidate personally inspected at least 8 bridges in 2023.
rationale: Eleven entails at least eight with unchanged actor, activity, unit and period; this guards against blanket rejection of unequal numbers.

premise: The candidate personally filed exactly 3 patent applications in total during 2024.
hypothesis: The candidate personally filed at least 7 patent applications during 2024.
rationale: The exhaustive total for the same actor, activity and period contradicts the higher lower bound. This is not a missing-context numerical comparison.

premise: In 2022 the company increased sales revenue by 18%. The candidate reduced stored file volume by 18% that year.
hypothesis: In 2022 the candidate personally increased sales revenue by 18%.
rationale: Equal percentages and year do not transfer a company-level sales outcome to the candidate, whose stated achievement concerns a different metric.

premise: In 2017 the candidate was a member of the hospital audit committee and was not its chair.
hypothesis: The candidate chaired the hospital audit committee in 2017.
rationale: Same actor, committee and period but an explicitly denied chair role; membership does not entail chairmanship.
